pois.name: Fort St. George
pois.description: The first British fortress built in India, established in 1644, with a museum & 17th-century church.
pois.intro: Fort St. George is a fortress at the coastal city of Chennai, India.

pois.name: Burma Bazaar
pois.intro: Burma Bazaar is a market run by Burmese refugees in Chennai, India. It is located at Parrys Corner and is one of the several unorganized or grey market shopping hubs of Chennai.

pois.name: Marina Beach
pois.intro: Marina Beach, or simply the Marina, is a natural urban beach in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, along the Bay of Bengal. The beach runs from near Fort St.

pois.name: சென்னை அரசு அருங்காட்சியகம்
pois.intro: The Government Museum, Chennai, or the Madras Museum, is a museum of human history and culture located in the Government Museum Complex in the neighbourhood of Egmore in Chennai, India. Started in 1851, it is the second oldest museum in India after the Indian Museum in Kolkata.

pois.name: Chepauk Palace
pois.intro: Chepauk Palace was the official residence of the Nawab of Arcot from 1768 to 1855. It is situated in the neighbourhood of Chepauk in Chennai, India, and is constructed in the Indo-Saracenic style of architecture.

pois.name: Valluvar Kottam
pois.intro: Valluvar Kottam is a monument in Chennai, dedicated to the classical Tamil poet philosopher Valluvar. It is the city's biggest Tamil cultural centre.

pois.name: Armenian Church of the Virgin Mary
pois.intro: Saint Mary Church of Chennai, constructed in 1712 and reconstructed in 1772, is one of the oldest churches of the Indian subcontinent, located in Chennai. It is famous for its belfry of six.

pois.name: George Town
pois.intro: George Town, also known as Muthialpet, Parry's Corner and Broadway, is a neighbourhood in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. It is near the Fort St.

pois.name: Royapuram
pois.intro: Royapuram railway station is a railway station at Royapuram, on the Chennai Beach–Walajapet section of the Chennai Suburban Railway network in Chennai, India. It is the second oldest railway station currently operational in India after Howrah railway station situated in Howrah, West Bengal and the first railway station of South India.

pois.name: Triumph of Labour
pois.intro: The Triumph of Labour, also known as the Labour statue, is a statue at the Marina Beach, Chennai, India. Erected at the northern end of the beach at the Anna Square opposite University of Madras, it is an important landmark of Chennai.

pois.name: Chennai Railway Museum
pois.intro: The Chennai Rail Museum is a railway museum in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. The museum opened on 16 April 2002 in the Furnishing Division of the Integral Coach Factory near Perambur.

pois.name: Central Square
pois.intro: The Central Square is a city square and major intersection in Chennai. Areas surrounding the Ripon Building, Victoria Public Hall, Moore Market Complex, Chennai Central Railway Station, the Southern Railway Headquarters and the Government General Hospital are being developed as part of the Central Square.

pois.name: Vivekanandar Illam
pois.intro: Vivekanandar Illam, earlier known as Ice House or Castle Kernan, is a historical building in Chennai, India. It was constructed in 1842 by Frederic Tudor.

pois.name: Zion Church
pois.intro: Zion Church is one of the oldest churches in Chintadripet area of Chennai, the capital of the South Indian state of Tamil Nadu. The original structure was built in Gothic architecture in 1847 by US missionaries.

pois.name: Bharat Insurance Building
pois.intro: Bharat Insurance building is a heritage building in Chennai, India. Located on the arterial Anna Salai, it was built in 1897.

pois.name: Mahakavi Subramania Bharati Memorial
pois.description: The historic Triplicane (Thiruvallikeni) residence in Chennai where the legendary Tamil poet and freedom fighter Subramania Bharati spent his final years from 1920 until his death in September 1921.

pois.name: Chennai Citi Center Mall
pois.intro: The Chennai Citi Centre is a shopping mall in Mylapore, Chennai, India. It opened on 3 March 2006 and is located on Radhakrishnan Salai.

pois.name: Alsa Mall Shopping Complex
pois.intro: Alsa Mall is a shopping mall on Montieth Road in the neighbourhood of Egmore in Chennai, India. Established in the mid-1980s, along with the Spencer Plaza, it is one of the oldest surviving malls in the city.

pois.name: Ampa Skywalk
pois.intro: Ampa Skyone is a shopping mall in Chennai, India. With three floors of retail space, it has outlets for major clothing and apparel brands, a seven-screen multiplex, a games zone and a food court.

pois.name: Semmozhi Poonga
pois.description: One of the largest parks in Chennai.
pois.intro: Semmozhi Poonga, variously spelled as Semmoli Poonga, is a botanical garden in Chennai set up jointly by the Horticulture and Agricultural Engineering department of the Government of Tamil Nadu. The garden was opened on 24 November 2010 by then chief Minister M. Karunanidhi and is the first botanical garden in the city.

pois.name: Anna Nagar Tower Park
pois.description: Anna Nagar Tower Park, officially known as Dr. Visveswaraya Tower Park, is an urban park in the suburb of Anna Nagar, Chennai. It is the tallest park tower in Chennai
pois.intro: Anna Nagar Tower Park, officially known as Dr Visvesvaraya Tower Park, is an urban park in the suburb of Anna Nagar, Chennai. It hosts a 133 ft tall watch tower, which was built in 1968.

pois.name: Madhavaram Botanical Garden
pois.intro: Madhavaram Botanical Garden is a botanical garden in Chennai, India, set up by the horticulture department of the Government of Tamil Nadu. The garden, the second botanical garden in Chennai after the Semmozhi Poonga, is the largest botanical garden in the city.

pois.name: Nageswara Rao Park
pois.intro: Nageswara Rao Park is a 4-acre park located on Luz Corner in Mylapore, Chennai, India. The park, with a separate play area for children, is kept open to the public from 5 a.m.

pois.name: Thiru Vi Ka Park
pois.intro: Thiru Vi Ka Park, also known as Shenoy Nagar Park, is an urban park at Chennai, India. The park is located in Shenoy Nagar.
